component.name: Pulse
component.summary: Web-first chat, voice and high-quality screen streaming

description.p: Pulse is a Discord-like chat, voice and streaming client. The desktop app is a thin Electron shell over the web app at howispulse.com; on Linux it adds high-quality, GPU-encoded screen streaming and a native viewer, both built into the package.
Einstellungen: neuer Schalter „beim Schließen beenden" (Desktop) + der Reiter „Erscheinungsbild" heißt jetzt „App".
Electron 43 (Chromium 150): neuer DTX-Sprachschalter (Datensparmodus in Sprechpausen) ohne Resume-Knacksen, schnellere IPC- und Startzeit.
First packaged build: Electron shell loading the deployed web app, plus the local screen-streaming bridge.
